summary_1line: Bhishma explains the supreme state beyond heaven, then narrates a tale of a devout reciter, a king, and a dispute about truth, merit, and gifts.

image_candidates.scene_text: After a thousand years of austerity, the radiant goddess Savitri appears before the silent Brahmana reciting the Gayatri at the foot of the Himalayas.
Dharma, Time, Yama, and Mrityu stand together before the serene Brahmana who calmly receives them with ritual hospitality.
The Brahmana and King Ikshvaku debate intensely before the gathered deities about truth, duty, and the fruits of sacred recitation.
